belief: Asking God more than once shows a lack of faith.
meta: A Christian look at the false belief that asking God more than once shows a lack of faith, with Scripture, questions, and homework for replacing it with the truth.
origins: Teaching that you should pray once and then “claim it.” Fear that repeating a request shows doubt. Feeling like a nuisance to God. A family where asking twice was seen as nagging. Confusion about how to keep praying without anxiety.
teaches: Jesus encouraged persistent prayer. He told a parable so that His followers would pray at all times and not lose heart. He said, “Ask… seek… knock,” words that suggest continuing. In Gethsemane, Jesus prayed a third time, saying the same thing. Paul pleaded with the Lord three times about his thorn. Asking again is not a lack of faith; it shows you are depending on God.
self_statements: I already asked, so asking again shows doubt.
God is tired of hearing about this.
I should just trust and stop asking.
If I believed, once would be enough.
God will be annoyed if I keep praying.
errors: Picturing God as annoyed, like an impatient person.
“I should only need to ask once.”
Overlooking Scripture’s encouragement to keep asking.
Believing persistence and faith cannot go together.
questions: Why did Jesus tell the parable in Luke 18?
What do “ask, seek, knock” suggest about continuing?
How many times did Jesus pray the same prayer in Gethsemane?
How many times did Paul ask about his thorn?
Is God annoyed by His children, or does He welcome them?
Can I keep asking while trusting God?
What request do I need to keep bringing to Him?
truth: Asking God more than once does not show a lack of faith. Jesus told me to keep praying and not lose heart. He Himself prayed the same prayer three times. God welcomes my persistent prayers. I can keep bringing my requests to Him with thanksgiving and trust Him with the answer.
hw_questions: Why did Jesus tell the parable in Luke 18?
How often did Jesus pray in Gethsemane?
How often did Paul ask about his thorn?
Is God annoyed by His children?
What request should I keep bringing?
hw_truths: Jesus told me to keep praying and not lose heart.
Asking again shows I depend on God.
I can keep asking, seeking, and knocking.
I can bring my requests with thanksgiving.
God’s peace guards my heart as I pray.
log: Each day, pray for my ongoing requests and mark the date. Note any changes.
name_example: Sarah can be anxious for nothing, but in everything, by prayer and petition, with thanksgiving, present her requests to God. And the peace of God, which surpasses all understanding, will guard her heart and her mind in Christ Jesus.
actions: Make a list of ongoing requests
and pray through it each morning for a week.
and write what Jesus says about persistence.
add one thing you are thankful for.
Ask a friend to pray persistently with you
tracker: I prayed for my ongoing requests
prayer: Father, thank You that You welcome my prayers again and again. Help me reject the lie that asking more than once shows a lack of faith. Teach me to keep praying and not lose heart, to bring my requests with thanksgiving, and to trust Your timing. In Jesus’ name, Amen.
